params.prompt: Cinematic product reveal teaser in the style of a PlayStation 5 console announcement trailer. Nighttime brand palette: midnight blue, violet, a discreet touch of gold. Elegant minimal on-screen text appears near the end: title 'NOCTURNA' with tagline 'Dors mieux dès ce soir', then a final end card on black background with glowing text '-20% · CODE : NOCTURNA20'.
